visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male athlete with short black hair, wearing a black tank top and shorts, is seen climbing through a large, heavy-duty black cargo net. He grips the rope firmly with gloved hands, his facial expression focused and determined as he maneuvers his body through the netting. The background consists of a bright, sunlit outdoor park with lush green grass and several leafy trees under a clear blue sky. Large white and yellow text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up shot of an informative park sign displaying a stylized map with green, yellow, and red lines representing 'easy', 'normal', and 'hard' challenge routes. The sign is mounted on a dark brown textured surface. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clear text and icons on the board. (3) The athlete continues his progress, now seen in a medium full shot navigating a high-altitude rope bridge. He holds onto vertical yellow ropes for stability while walking across suspended wooden platforms. Below him, the protective black netting spans the entire area. The camera follows his movement from a side view, capturing his balanced posture and controlled leg movements. (4) A second male character, wearing a light grey oversized t-shirt and glasses, is briefly shown traversing a wooden climbing wall with dark brown square holds. He moves laterally, his hands gripping the edges of the blocks while his feet find steady placement on lower rungs. The scene is framed as a medium shot against a backdrop of a black chain-link fence. (5) The first athlete is shown sliding down a vertical rope using a pulley system, his expression shifting from intense concentration to a triumphant smile as he looks directly at the camera. He points his gloved finger forward in a gesture of engagement. A graphic search bar with '健人蓋伊' and social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube appears over the scene. (6) The final sequence shows a collage of shots featuring both men successfully completing various obstacles, including a high climbing net and swinging rings. The footage is edited with rapid cuts, showing various hand-to-eye coordination tasks. The background features a large elevated highway structure in the distance, indicating the park's urban-fringe location.
